## Research question

::: {.question}
How should solar PV, battery storage and backup generation be sized for an industrial research campus to meet demand through grid outages, and how do equipment failures and maintenance affect a battery production line and a wind farm?
:::

## My contribution

Intern. Built the microgrid sizing model and the production-line simulation, and proposed the wind-farm maintenance framework.

## Method

Techno-economic optimization of solar PV, battery and backup sizing that minimizes the levelized cost of energy while meeting demand in modeled grid-outage scenarios, using a DOE reference load profile scaled to the campus's annual consumption and site solar data; discrete-event simulation (Arena) of a lithium battery production line to quantify the effect of equipment failures and maintenance schedules and to locate bottlenecks; a proposed optimization framework for predictive and corrective maintenance scheduling of wind farms.

::: {.callout-note title="Boundary conditions"}
Industry work: company data, models and results are confidential and are not shown here.
:::
